Effect synchronizes external singleton (Presence.setStatus) on setting change. No React state set. Matches React docs 'Synchronizing with external systems' — canonical Effect usage, not 'You might not need an Effect'.
Identical pattern to UserPresenceProvider:23 — Effect calls VideoConfManager.setLogLevel(logLevel) on prop change. External singleton write, no React state.

Effect pushes React `value` into the CodeMirror editor instance (third-party imperative library). Misclassified as E2 — not a calc, no memoizable value. Matches React docs 'Synchronizing with external systems'. Library bridge — keep.

Effect writes to the `emoji.packages.emojiCustom` external singleton + calls `emoji.dispatchUpdate()`. Misclassified as E2 — no calc to memoize. External-system sync, family same as UserPresence/VideoConf. See stylistic_followups for ergonomic cleanup.

Misclassified — `contextValue` is already wrapped in useMemo at line 28-53. Line 55 is the start of the mouseover-subscribe Effect, which is the same Effect as the line:129 E11 finding (double-counted). No E2 anti-pattern here.
Effect notifies parent on `useUserPresence` status change — driven by presence stream, not user action. External-state sync (presence query → parent notify); no handler exists to host the call. Drop.

Effect calls `registerDownloadForUid(uid, t, title)` which subscribes once via `ee.once(uid, ...)`. The Effect is one-shot emitter setup, not a parent-callback fire. Closer to E8 (init-on-mount) but ee.once self-cleans. Drop.

Effect adds `change` listener to a DOM input element with proper add/remove cleanup. The parent `onSetFile` callback fires from inside the DOM event handler, not from the Effect itself. Canonical DOM bridge. Drop.
Same shape as useSingleFileInput — DOM `addEventListener('${id}_idle'/_active')` bridge. Callbacks wrapped in useEffectEvent and invoked from inside the listener. Canonical DOM bridge. Drop.

Effect calls `setToken(token || null)` which writes to localStorage via useSamlInviteToken. External-system sync (URL → storage), not parent-callback. File has a `// TODO: this is so hacky` comment — architectural cleanup belongs elsewhere (route loader). Drop.

Effect dispatches desktop notification when `sessionInfo.state === 'ringing'`. Call state is driven by external SIP signaling (peer-initiated), not user action. No user handler exists where the dispatch could live. Canonical external-system sync to RocketChatDesktop notification API.

Effect fires toast once per session when unverified email loads, guarded by warnedRef — same shape as React docs `didInit` flag for one-time init. Triggered by user data arrival from query, not user action. Canonical.

Effect plays dialer/ringer audio based on external call `state` (driven by SIP signaling, not user action). Cleanup returns the stop fn — sound stops on state transition. Canonical external-state sync.
Effect subscribes to callEnded emitter via `subscribeCallEnded(callback)`. Canonical emitter bridge with auto-cleanup.
Effect calls `setDateFnsLocale(language)` to sync the date-fns global locale singleton when app language changes. External singleton write — canonical external-system sync.
Effect fires a global `room-opened` analytics event on room data arrival. Trigger is route entry (rid change), not user action. Cross-cutting analytics belongs in an Effect.
Effect calls `RoomManager.open(rid)` on mount + `RoomManager.back(rid)` on cleanup — lifecycle bridge to external RoomManager singleton. Canonical.
Effect performs `router.navigate(...)` when subscription metadata (name/type) changes server-side. Reactive navigation on external state — there is no user-event handler where this could live.

Effect cleans up Rooms.state and queryClient queries when the useQuery result errors. useQuery v5 doesn't expose an onError option; reacting to `result.error` in an Effect is the current canonical TanStack pattern.

Effect calls `sdk.stream('integrationHistory', [id], ...)` — RC streamer subscription. Should have been carved out. Not a mutation. The `mounted` state flag toggles after clear-history to drop the subscription, not for one-time init.
Effect calls `mediaSession.setWebRTCProcessorFactory(...)` — config write to mediaSession singleton when ICE servers / timeout change. External-state sync, not a mutation/chain.
Effect uses `notifyUserStream('media-signal', ...)` — RC `useStream` carve-out should apply. Not a fetch/mutation.
Form container `.focus()` on mount with tabIndex={-1} for screen-reader announcement. <form autoFocus> does not apply, programmatic focus is the only path. Canonical mount-only DOM imperative.
Same form-container .focus() pattern as RegisterForm — canonical.
Same form-container .focus() pattern as RegisterForm — canonical.
Effect runs runtime validation (logs + dev-only throw) when LDAP/CROWD settings change. Settings can flip live via admin UI, so the dep set is correct; this isn't an init-once anti-pattern.
Effect constructs a TonePlayer on mount and destroys it on unmount — canonical Effect-managed resource lifecycle, not 'init in Effect' with missing cleanup.

Effect reacts to react-aria's OverlayTriggerState.isOpen (library-owned state) and collapses the navbar when the overlay closes. No user-event handler exists where this could move; canonical library-state reaction.

stylistic_followups.note: Effect re-initializes `emoji.packages.emojiCustom` registry object on every dep transition. Cleaner: initialize at module load, react only to `result.isSuccess` inside Effect. Stylistic, not an anti-pattern.
